item.description: Keyboard The demo file in this tutorial was created by Leonardo Amora, owner of http://www.amoraleite.com You can download the source files here. See page1.pst in Photoshop/Keyboar folder. Dynamic Text & Variables let’s enable a text layer to display the value of a variable.
